styles.name: 自然纪实
styles.look: NATURALISTIC CONTEMPORARY CHINESE DRAMA photography. Soft overcast daylight outside, neutral-to-warm household tungsten inside, restrained color grading, lifelike skin, simple observed performance. Film still captured with a full-frame digital cinema camera and 40mm lens, moderate depth of field, faces and hands clear. Medium contrast with readable shadows, no glamour retouching or cinematic teal-orange excess. The subjects feel like ordinary family members caught in a genuine event.

Create an ORIGINAL PHOTOREAL LIVE-ACTION CINEMA LOOK TEST for a fictional Chinese science-fiction story. This must look like photographed live actors in real ordinary locations with restrained invisible VFX, NOT an illustration, drawing, anime, comic, painting, game render, wax model, or 3D character. Natural facial asymmetry, believable skin and fabric, realistic contact shadows, human hands. Entire cast is fictional, no celebrity likeness.
One wide contact sheet with exactly THREE equally sized portrait 9:16 frames side by side, thin neutral gutters. Each frame is a separate complete film still. No titles, panel numbers, writing, subtitles, logos or speech bubbles. Keep the SAME MAN in all three frames of this sheet: 29-year-old Chinese man, lean long face, natural short black hair with a subtle right part, small notch near outer LEFT eyebrow, ordinary quietly appealing working-person appearance rather than fashion idol, dark navy short jacket over off-white crew neck, black trousers, worn WHITE sneakers. Late scene has only slight stubble and tired eyes, still age 29.
LEFT FRAME: a grey rainy contemporary Chinese street. The young man stands on the RIGHT holding a small transparent bag of eggs in his LEFT hand, startled but unharmed. In the LEFT foreground a heavy truck has mechanically come apart just before reaching him: the cab is tilted but grounded, a whole detached bumper lies on wet asphalt, detached wheels and an intact heavy engine assembly rest separately on the ground, a clear open safety gap in front of the man. Photograph the AFTERMATH of impossible automatic disassembly as sober realistic VFX. Gravity and solid weight believable: NO hovering truck, exploded fragments suspended in the air, flames, blast, smoke wall, liquid metal, gore or collision with a person. Wet road and ordinary midrise buildings in background, not dystopian ruin.
MIDDLE FRAME: warm, modest real apartment kitchen, medium shot with upper bodies and arms visible. The same man tightly embraces his 58-year-old Chinese mother, who is fully alive and physically present. She has a naturally aged face, grey-black hair in low bun, beige knitted sweater and simple pale sage-green apron. Her LEFT hand gently pats his back and her RIGHT hand hangs naturally holding a plain metal soup ladle. He looks frightened and attached, she looks caring and slightly puzzled, not a posed advertising family. A pot of soup and steam behind them, soft warm practical kitchen lights. Correct natural embrace and hands, restrained acting. No ghosts, extra people, transparent bodies or disappearance effect.
RIGHT FRAME: same modest apartment with wooden table centered, window on LEFT, open kitchen rear RIGHT. The same man now slightly tired sits on the RIGHT, holding an intact smartphone in his RIGHT hand, looking toward an EMPTY CHAIR on the LEFT. Exactly two white soup bowls on table, delicate steam. A small simple white plush rabbit rests against that empty chair, a blue fabric patch on the RABBIT'S OWN LEFT EAR. Same dark navy jacket, black trousers, worn white shoes if visible. Just one living person in this frame; windows and reflections show no other people. Empty space and two bowls carry the grief, no tears-to-camera melodrama, no photos of a ghost mother, no ruined apartment. Composition readable, calm upper-body scale; slight uncluttered lower space for later subtitles but DO NOT add text.
Photorealistic live-action film frame capture, coherent lenses and believable real lighting; modest selective detail, not over-sharpened, no fish-scale surface pattern, no excessive microtexture, no crunchy HDR. Real humans visibly different from stylized anime faces.

Outside steel-blue and grey rain, inside muted amber practical kitchen light, skin natural and separated from the background. Full-frame digital cinema still, natural 50mm lens perspective, precise selective focus, subtle cinematic contrast, rich but readable dark areas. Powerful cold-versus-warm emotional contrast, calm expensive-looking framing, no neon cyberpunk, no painted look and no beauty-filter face.

Soft low-key lighting, charcoal and restrained olive-grey palette outside, localized ordinary kitchen practicals with warm skin indoors. Film still captured with a 40mm lens and carefully controlled exposure, dark negative space has visible geometry, faces and hands well exposed. Tactile ordinary real materials, minimalist blocking, an uneasy stillness rather than graphic horror. NOT crushed-black or sepia monochrome; no invented fog, film scratches, exaggerated pores or grit.
